original_question: Henry yana yin bisckit din kukis don gasar yin kayan ci daga fulawa na gida. Yana son ya linka sau biyun abinda yayi a bara. Bayan ya gama toya, sai ya gane cewa a zahiri ya toya biskit din kukis 15 fiye da yadda yake so.
